Name: Pokemon Alolan Vulpix as Cat
Author: AlolaVulpixIsLife
Description:
INSTALLATION

Be sure to create a backup of orignal files first if you don't want to take any risks.

1. Go to C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Animals 

2. Copy and paste the cat.xnb file from the download into this Animals folder.

3. Overwrite file


*Note

This sprite is not made by me, I only did the pallet swap to the Alolan version. 

The sprites for this Vulpix are extracted from the game Pokemon Mystery Dungeon: Explores of Time/Darkness/Sky


I am uploading this for all of you Alolan Vulpix lovers because I can’t find any other mods that do this

If you find anything wrong with the sprite, let me know and I will do my best to fix it.
